sights.address: 244 Ba Tháng Hai, Ward 12, District 10, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
sights.w: A landmark District 10 Buddhist temple on Ba Tháng Hai (3/2) Boulevard, originally built in 1964 and rebuilt 2014–2017 around a soaring 13-storey stupa (Tháp Đa Bảo). A historically significant seat of Vietnamese Buddhism and a striking, uncrowded stop; upper floors open on the 1st and 15th of the lunar month.
